recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the API-facing portion of FHIR-20574 now that Device.category and its terminology are present; handle any future THO binding migration separately when FHIR-55253 is applied.
issue_request: FHIR-20574 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Device change request, raised in STU3 and applied for R5, asking for high-level Device.category support and a token category search parameter to distinguish API-relevant device categories such as implantable devices, durable medical equipment, personal health devices, point-of-care devices, reusable devices, prosthetics, and software.
initial_application: The historical application commit 3c23148747a7d0fead21ff9afaab2fc3bb65eae9 updated Device and DeviceDefinition scope/boundary narrative for FHIR-20574 and related Device issues. A later commit, 14e5c20f1f34a491dd0b8af3b9f1bf8bc1082b2c, added Device.category as a 0..* CodeableConcept bound to ValueSet/device-category. The combined branch already includes FHIR-32080 commit 76fc66224becc78b5b0432e9e02e7c9d5f42bf0f to complete the category terminology. Before this reconciliation, no Device-category search parameter existed in source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml.
additional_context: The accepted Device Scope-Boundary-Relationships page says devices may have one or more categories and lists the high-level category examples. Later Published Device issues FHIR-32080 and FHIR-35984 support category terminology and category examples. FHIR-55253 may later move Device category terminology to THO, but it is only Resolved - change required and does not supersede current core search support. The earlier DeviceDefinition.category idea was not carried into the final scope/boundary resolution and would require broader model review, so it was not changed.
reconciliation: Added a build-scoped SearchParameter entry to source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml with id Device-category, code category, token type, expression Device.category, and Device.category path metadata.
source_changes: source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml: added Device-category token SearchParameter over Device.category.
